item.text: Australina pusilla, commonly called small shade nettle, is a highly variable perennial herb in the nettle family (Urticaceae). It grows up to 50 cm tall, often beside shady streams, and is native to eastern Australia and New Zealand. Two subspecies are recognized: subsp. muelleri and subsp. pusilla. [s1:p1–p2]
